title: Foldable Project View rule set
description: Folding rules of the Foldable Project View plugin: a `.foldableprojectview.yaml` file of a project, the user `rules.yaml`, or a preset.

name.description: Name of the rule set. Required for presets, where it is shown in the `+` menu of the rules table.

tags.description: Keywords used to group and suggest the presets, like `gradle` or `docs`.

extends.description: Other rule sets to include before the rules of this one, by id: `builtin:docs` for a built-in preset, `user:gradle` for a preset of the user directory. A rule of this set with the id of an included rule overrides it.

options.description: Options applied to the projects using this rule set; the keys left out keep the IDE settings.

foldNestedDirectories.description: Fold in nested directories, not only in the module roots.

hideEmptyGroups.description: Hide the groups that match nothing.

rules.description: Folding rules, applied in order – the first matching rule takes precedence.

color.description: A palette color (Blue, Green, Orange, Rose, Violet, Yellow, Gray) following the IDE theme, or a custom `#RRGGBB` / `#AARRGGBB` color.

patterns.description: Gitignore-like glob patterns, as a list or a single space-separated text: `*` matches any characters but `/`, `**` any number of directories, `?` a single character, `[abc]` one of the listed characters; a leading `/` anchors the pattern to the module root, a trailing `/` matches directories only, a leading `!` excludes the matched elements.

id.description: Stable identity of the rule, used by `extends` and by the IDE settings to override it. Derived from the name (`CI/CD` becomes `ci-cd`) when missing.

name.description: Label of the folding group in the Project View.

patternsFiles.description: Paths of ignore-like files with one pattern per line (`.foldignore`, `.dockerignore`), relative to the module content root. A rule lists either `patterns` or `patternsFiles`.

type.description: What the rule matches: `patterns` (default when `patterns` is present), `patternsFiles` (default when `patternsFiles` is present), or `ignoredFiles` for the built-in rule folding the VCS-ignored files.

icon.description: Built-in IDE icon for the folding group, like `AllIcons.Nodes.Folder` or `Folder`.

action.description: `group` moves the matched elements into a folding group (default), `hide` removes them from the Project View.

enabled.description: Disabled rules are kept, but not applied.
